label: exploratory
description: CAL-H0: maximum-likelihood fit of the median initial half-life h0 on the fit user split only (exponential form, sigma fixed at sqrt(0.5^2 + 0.3^2) = 0.5831), by the method committed in 29d0dfb before fitting. No simulation, no arm, no contrast involved; the held-out split was not touched.
outcome: h0 = 67.590 days (naive likelihood-ratio 95% interval 66.70 to 68.49; not on a grid edge); log-likelihood -95,683.07; 163,110 rows, 245,827 trials, 219,958 successes (pooled recall 0.895); runtime 5.1 s. Rounded value 67.59 days replaces the planning value 1 day; EXP-002 h0 axis {33.8, 67.59, 135.18} days. Interpretation: Duolingo first-repeat in-session accuracy stays high for weeks, so the planning value of 1 day was far below the real order of magnitude; this is the main cause of the floor regime DG-1.

label: confirmatory (preregistered descriptive test, P§14.4)
exp_id: EXP-001 (reported there; does not test H1)
outcome: Evaluated once. Held-out split 161243 rows, 243337 trials. Log-likelihood per trial: constant -0.3352, power -0.3710 (h0 96.62 d), exponential -0.3865 (h0 67.59 d). Reading: exponential does not beat the constant baseline (negative result); power-law better supported than exponential. Observed recall 0.904 at 1-2 days to 0.872 at 32-90 days; both forms predict much steeper decay. Runtime 46.838 s.
